figurative_meaning_en: To view the world through one's own lens or as a reflection of oneself
similar_in_english: To think the world revolves around oneself
To judge others by one's own standards
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে আত্মবৎ মন্যতে জগৎ, তাই সকলের কাজকে তার নিজের মাপকাঠিতে যাচাই করে।
এই ধরনের মানুষ আত্মবৎ মন্যতে জগৎ, ফলে অন্যের দৃষ্টিভঙ্গি বুঝতে পারে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He views the world as revolving around himself, so he measures everyone's actions by his own standards.
People like that see the world in their own image, failing to understand others' perspectives.
history: This idiom originates from Sanskrit philosophical expressions, often used in classical Bengali literature to describe self-projection onto the world.
note: Derived from Sanskrit 'Ātmavat manyate jagat', emphasizing subjective worldview in Bengali cultural discourse.
